source.note: Original Lightweight topic and copy (owner request 2026-10-19). Format: question hook → immediate answer → rules that change how you count → fix → product. Visual templates: our approved slides plus two Arrow slides used only as component references (table, ✓/✗ list).

visual_templates.week_table_component: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50d65c7d-3cbf-4e0f-bca2-6fafc9acf592 (REF-003 slide 10, layout of the DAY table only)

wordmark.transform: direct pixel copy, no scaling, every slide

phone_ending.transform: Uniformly scale accepted 1080x830 phone/hand bitmap to width 780 px (780x599 rounded output), then place at x300,y750; no independent-axis stretching, no screen re-rendering.
phone_ending.screen: existing accepted Muscle balance composite; not a separately available original raw screenshot
phone_ending.assembly_layout_note: The top/background generation stage uses more vertical space for the complete copy than initially reserved. Required final asset assembly therefore uses the explicit series rule to move/shrink the phone rather than cover or shrink text. No regeneration, OCR or additional review tool call.

slides.prompt:
Create ONE ORIGINAL Lightweight carousel slide, LW-CAR-0007, a clean portrait 1080x1350 PNG (4:5). This is our own topic, NOT a reproduction of competitor copy. Use only the attached own Lightweight template(s) for series identity and the explicitly named component references for their geometry. The task is frozen copy content_version 1.1.

SERIES: off-white #F0F1EB background, very large pale coral #FBE3DD rounded arch rising on the right behind content. Accent #F26445, dark #2A2A2A, body grey #6B6B6B, badge white #FFFFFF. Real RUBIK typography throughout: heaviest cover and large numbers, bold titles, regular body and exercise labels. Same premium clean series, fine grey anatomy outlines, soft fine muscle-relief linework, plenty of space. No green, sage, gradients on target highlights, shadows except the cover's soft grey text offset. No TikTok UI, signatures, watermarks, added words or invented symbols.

WORDMARK: the small actual accepted Lightweight wordmark at x~45,y~40 is an existing bitmap asset. Do not draw or invent a new logo. Reserve the full top strip y=0..110 for exact restoration of that source bitmap during planned asset assembly; you may leave that strip empty. All headline text starts below y=135. The same accepted source strip will be copied into the final export with no rescaling. No other branding.

MANNEQUINS: smooth plastic educational ANATOMY MANNEQUINS, bald featureless head and face, featureless smooth pelvis with no genital detail. Warm sand #D9CBBE muscles, darker same-sand shading, ivory #F5F0E5 tendons/skin, fine grey linework matching our own attached series. All full-body or knees-up figures wear plain opaque short athletic shorts in sand #D9CBBE as explicitly permitted in this task. Nothing green. Target muscles only as specified below get flat coral #F26445. Gym equipment realistic black/grey/white. No real human skin or nude person.

COPY: The numbered list of strings below gives the ONLY slide copy. Keep every string, spelling, capitalization and punctuation EXACTLY. Do not add a period to a headline without one. Line breaks may wrap a long string, but never omit words or change apostrophes, hyphens or punctuation. All text fully visible and readable; no text under an illustration, clipped by an edge, or hidden behind a phone. If space is needed, move or shrink the illustration, never the text. Keep at least 55 px left/right and bottom text safety margins. No extra captions from reference images.

SLIDE 1 COVER. Copy the stacked headline, soft grey offset text shadow, and anatomical illustration style of our LW-CAR-0001 cover. Three uppercase lines in the top ~45%, with EXACT line breaks:
HOW MANY
SETS DO YOU
ACTUALLY NEED?
First two lines dark; last line coral. Use heaviest Rubik, scale the three-line headline to fit its longest line within 960 px without changing line breaks or substituting a narrow condensed font. Below it, from knees upward, one anatomical mannequin in front three-quarter view, standing mid-repetition of a dumbbell biceps curl, elbows by torso. Neutral featureless faceless head with focused posture; only BICEPS highlighted coral. Keep both dumbbells credible and separate. Plain sand shorts. To the mannequin's right ONLY, four small neat coral circular set-counter badges stacked vertically with white numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, in that order, one of each. No other diagrams, graphic icons or words. Figure may reach/crop at bottom, but do not overlap headline.

EXACT SLIDE COPY STRINGS (quotation marks below delimit strings; do not print delimiter quotes):
1. "HOW MANY"
2. "SETS DO YOU"
3. "ACTUALLY NEED?"
slides.export_method: Uniform scale to fit 1080x1350 followed by centered canvas extent; exact preplanned wordmark strip copy. No independent-axis stretching.
